title: Adoption Mosaic: Scoring Framework & Signal Synthesis
body:
Purpose:
This is a working-framework for synthesizing disparate adoption signals into a single, explainable customer health score meant to drive renewal prioritization, early risk detection, and targeted success plays. The goal is to be pragmatic: support spreadsheet-friendly calculations for CS managers while also indicating how signals could be ingested downstream by analytics pipelines.

Guiding principles:
- Multi-dimensional: treat adoption as a mosaic (usage, depth, velocity, product breadth, support friction).
- Explainable: each score component must be mappable back to 1–2 raw signals for triage.
- Tunable: quick knobs for weight tweaks per segment (startup / mid-market / enterprise).
- Temporal: capture both steady-state adoption and recent momentum/decay.
- Threshold-first: generate clear discrete flags then aggregate to a score.

Signal inventory (raw metrics to consider):
1) API activity: daily active API keys (7d MA), tokens/day per account, percent of requests using streaming.
2) Feature breadth: number of distinct endpoints used (generation, chat, embeddings, reranking).
3) Depth of calls: median tokens per successful request (indicates richness of usage).
4) Embedding footprint: embeddings calls / month and search queries per embedding.
5) User seats / integrations: non-developer seats enabled, production routes created, infra integrations (Dedicated/Private).
6) Time-to-first-value (TTFV): days from signup to first production call or first scheduled job.
7) Support friction: open P1/P2 tickets (30d), escalations, average time to first response.
8) Reliability exposure: percent of requests routed to fallback, rate of degraded-model fallbacks.
9) Billing signals: spend velocity (3mo slope), invoice disputes, overage spikes.
10) Eval/quality signals: rate of quality alerts from Redwood Optimize, undifferentiated outputs flagged by QA sets.
11) Product signals: feature flags usage (e.g., caching, batch endpoints enabled), KV cache adoption.
12) Engagement signals: weekly active developers, help center searches for advanced features.

Signal types and preprocessing notes:
- Rate/ratio signals (tokens/day, embeddings/month): log-transform then normalize to 0–1 by segment percentiles.
- Binary signals (production_integration=true): map to 0/1 but allow weight bump for enterprise.
- Change/momentum signals (3mo slope): center on 0 (negative trend -> penalty).
- Missing data: impute with conservative defaults (e.g., treat null production usage as 0 but tag as "unknown integration" for outreach).

Suggested score components (each 0–100):
A. Usage Intensity (weight default 30): tokens/day normalized + active API keys.
B. Product Breadth (weight default 20): number of endpoints used + feature flags adoption.
C. Production Maturity (weight default 20): TTFV, presence of dedicated capacity, infra integrations.
D. Stability & Support (weight default 15): open escalations, fallback rates, reliability exposures.
E. Momentum (weight default 15): spend velocity, trend in active users, recent embedding queries increase.

Weighting guidance by segment (quick presets):
- Startup: intensity 35 / breadth 15 / maturity 10 / stability 15 / momentum 25
- Mid-market: intensity 30 / breadth 20 / maturity 20 / stability 15 / momentum 15
- Enterprise: intensity 25 / breadth 20 / maturity 30 / stability 15 / momentum 10

Risk band definitions (final aggregated score 0–100):
- Green (>= 70): on track. Maintain standard play cadence.
- Amber (45–69): watchlist. Trigger a low-touch outreach (check-in, usage tips, enable caching).
- Red (< 45): intervention. CS owner assigned, technical review, rollout health check, potential renewal conversation prep.

Discrete flags (examples) — generate alongside continuous score:
- Low-Depth Flag: median tokens/request < X percentile for segment OR repeated short requests pattern.
- No-Production Flag: no confirmed production route / scheduling after 45 days.
- Escalation Flag: any P1 in last 30 days or >3 P2.
- Spend-Decline Flag: spend 30d down >40% vs prior 90d baseline.
- Feature-Stall Flag: fewer than 2 new endpoints adopted in 60 days for accounts > 6 months.
- Embedding-Plateau Flag: embedding queries flat for >90 days after initial spike.

Playbook mapping (action quick-cards):
1) Green: monthly check-in, share quarterly adoption recipes, surface Optimize suggestions automatically.
2) Amber: 2-week diagnostic play — automated report + 30-min onboarding to enable KV cache or batching. Offer incentives for scheduled migration to Dedicated if relevant.
3) Red: immediate S.E. deep-dive, prioritized bug/latency triage, executive sync if renewal within 90d. Draft renewal risk memo with evidence (signals + ticket links).

Spreadsheet-ready columns (minimal):
- account_id, segment, created_date, last_active_date, tokens_7d, tokens_median_per_call, endpoints_count, embeddings_30d, ttfv_days, p1_30d, fallback_rate_pct, spend_30d, spend_slope_90d, score_component_usage, score_component_breadth, score_component_maturity, score_component_stability, score_component_momentum, aggregate_score, risk_band, discrete_flags (semicolon-separated), recommended_play

Worked example (toy):
- AcmeCo (mid-market): tokens_7d=120k -> usage_component=68, endpoints=3 -> breadth=45, has Dedicated=false ttfv=12d -> maturity=40, fallback_rate=0.8% -> stability=85, spend_slope=+12% -> momentum=60. Weighted aggregate -> 0.3*68 +0.2*45 +0.2*40 +0.15*85 +0.15*60 = 20.4+9+8+12.75+9 = 59.15 -> 59 -> Amber. Flag: No-Production? (false), Feature-Stall? (maybe). Recommended play: 2-week diagnostic + enable batching.

Operational notes / automation ideas:
- Compute weekly; mark any account with missing critical data for manual outreach.
- Store raw signals and final score in customer profile; keep a 6-month history for trend detection.
- Expose top-3 contributing signals in UI so AE/CS can easily justify outreach.
- Add a lightweight change control for weight tweaks: record who changed weights and why.

Open questions / trade-offs to resolve:
- How to treat free-tier churn vs paid accounts — should free accounts be excluded from momentum weighting? (proposal: separate baseline for free vs paid).
- Should qualitative NPS/CSAT be included? (CSAT often lags; include as separate influence multiplier for renewals).
- Degree of smoothing for momentum signals (moving average window 14 vs 30 days?).
- Enforcement for missing telemetry in Private deployments — rely more on account-reported usage.

Next steps (short):
- Validate top 8 signals availability in instrumentation and mapping (Ravi).
- Build a one-sheet spreadsheet prototype that calculates components per segment (Lena).
- Run sample on 200 accounts to calibrate percentiles and weights (Marcus + Analytics).
- Share with GTM for playbook alignment and beta pilot (CS owners).

Notes to self / TODOs:
- Add quick links to existing evaluation sets used by Optimize (need list).
- Draft sample email cadence for Amber -> Red escalation.
- Prepare a Confluence page with signal definitions, SQL snippets, and alerting thresholds.

References / links embedded above.
